name: xTool F1 Ultra
tagline: Portable dual-laser (fiber + diode) for metal marking and fast engraving
tldr: A compact desktop machine combining a 20W fiber laser and 20W diode. The fiber module marks bare metal : stainless steel, aluminum, brass : without spray. Ideal for jewelry, knives, and metal gifts. Premium price for a small work area.

specs.workArea: 100 × 100 mm (3.9 × 3.9 in) standard; larger with conveyor

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

beginnerNotes: This profile covers xTool F1 Ultra. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Use the fiber module for all metal work. The diode is a bonus for wood/leather on the same desk. Rotary attachment is essential for rings and cylindrical metal. Dial in power/speed on scrap : fiber is unforgiving on thin metal.
primaryUse: Professional metal marking and small-item engraving for jewelry, personalization businesses, and tool marking.
mainObjective: Direct bare-metal marking for jewelry, tools & personalization

moduleSystem.headline: Fiber + diode in one desktop unit
moduleSystem.description: The F1 Ultra switches between a fiber source (metal) and a diode source (wood/acrylic) inside one chassis. You do not swap a 10W diode for a 40W diode : that is the xTool S1 model.

editorialDepth.advantages: xTool F1 Ultra 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU : clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame : glasses and exhaust required. Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.
